title: cynoglossum furcatum var. villosulum
intro: Cynoglossum furcatum var. villosulum, commonly known as the Hairy Forked Hound's Tongue, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The Hairy Forked Hound's Tongue is valued for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits, such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
